mapper.select: SELECT id AS "id", schedule_date AS "date", (SELECT cln.name FROM clients cln WHERE cln.client_code = logistics_schedule.client_code LIMIT 1) AS "clientName", (SELECT CASE WHEN pdn.spec IS NOT NULL AND pdn.spec != '' THEN pdn.name || '(' || pdn.spec || ')' ELSE pdn.name END FROM products pdn WHERE pdn.code = logistics_schedule.product_code) AS "itemName", COALESCE(actual_qty, order_qty) AS "qtyText" FROM logistics_schedule WHERE schedule_date BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end} AND ship_confirmed = 1 ORDER BY id

SELECT id AS "id", logistics_date AS "date", (SELECT cln.name FROM clients cln WHERE cln.client_code = production_schedule.client_code LIMIT 1) AS "clientName", (SELECT CASE WHEN pdn.spec IS NOT NULL AND pdn.spec != '' THEN pdn.name || '(' || pdn.spec || ')' ELSE pdn.name END FROM products pdn WHERE pdn.code = production_schedule.product_code) AS "itemName", COALESCE(logistics_actual_qty, actual_qty, order_qty) AS "qtyText" FROM production_schedule WHERE logistics_date BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end} AND ship_confirmed = 1 ORDER BY id
SELECT schedule_type AS "scheduleType", schedule_id AS "scheduleId", COALESCE(SUM(qty), 0) AS "qty" FROM delivery_carryover GROUP BY schedule_type, schedule_id

SELECT co.schedule_type AS "scheduleType", co.schedule_id AS "scheduleId", co.client_name AS "clientName", co.product_name AS "itemName", co.qty AS "qty", co.unit_price AS "unitPrice", co.amount AS "amount", co.original_date AS "date" FROM delivery_carryover co WHERE ((co.target_date IS NOT NULL AND co.target_date <> '' AND co.target_date BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end}) OR ((co.target_date IS NULL OR co.target_date = '') AND co.target_month BETWEEN #{startMonth} AND #{endMonth})) AND CASE WHEN co.schedule_type = 'logistics' THEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM logistics_schedule l WHERE l.id = co.schedule_id AND COALESCE(l.ship_confirmed, 0) <> 0) ELSE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM production_schedule p WHERE p.id = co.schedule_id AND COALESCE(p.ship_confirmed, 0) <> 0) END ORDER BY co.id
SELECT p.name AS "name", p.spec AS "spec", (SELECT COALESCE(pr.current_price, pr.total_price) FROM pricing pr WHERE pr.product_code = p.code LIMIT 1) AS "unitPrice" FROM products p ORDER BY p.code

SELECT id AS "id", receive_date AS "date", (SELECT cln.name FROM clients cln WHERE cln.client_code = material_receiving.client_code LIMIT 1) AS "clientName", material_name AS "itemName", qty AS "qty", unit_price AS "unitPrice", supply_amount AS "supplyAmount", vat_amount AS "vatAmount", total_amount AS "amount" FROM material_receiving WHERE receive_date BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end} ORDER BY receive_date, id
SELECT DISTINCT name COLLATE "C" AS name FROM clients WHERE name IS NOT NULL AND name <> '' ORDER BY 1
SELECT name AS "name", spec AS "spec" FROM products WHERE COALESCE(discontinued, 0) = 0 ORDER BY name COLLATE "C", code

SELECT name FROM clients WHERE client_type IN ( SELECT i.item_code FROM tb_common_code_item i JOIN tb_common_code_group g ON g.common_code_group_id = i.group_id AND g.group_code = 'CUSTOMER_CATEGORY' JOIN tb_tenant t ON t.tenant_id = g.tenant_id AND t.tenant_code = 'SONGYEON' WHERE i.item_nm LIKE '%매입%' ) AND COALESCE(use_yn, 'Y') = 'Y' AND name IS NOT NULL ORDER BY name COLLATE "C"
SELECT DISTINCT name COLLATE "C" AS name FROM clients WHERE name IS NOT NULL AND name <> '' AND COALESCE(use_yn, 'Y') = 'Y' ORDER BY 1
SELECT name FROM materials WHERE name IS NOT NULL AND name <> '' ORDER BY name COLLATE "C"
